title: Package manifest, version 1
description: A partner's manifest as the shop's administrator installs it from the Retail Extension Package screen or a sandbox's API (lane pkginstall). The schema holds the manifest's own shape: its name, prefix and version (required, major.minor.patch) and the kinds it may carry. Every element inside a kind is judged by the checker itself, inside the site, at the check and again at the install (business_logic/manifest_check.py validate). Page: docs/extending/package_install.md.

app.description: The prefix in lower case with underscores.

prefix.description: One to three upper-case words; every name the manifest creates starts with it.

version.description: major.minor.patch, compared as numbers: an update must be higher.

doctypes.description: The doctypes the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).
